fields.title: Is it worth opening an API
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each product, state whether the three effects — distribution, retention, long tail — work and whether you should open a public API.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — none work, the buyer doesn't build processes around it. 2 — retention is strong (embedded in HR processes), long tail exists (payroll integrations), yes. 3 — distribution and tail work, but regulations make this a separate project; the decision isn't architectural. 4 — all three, it's a platform product by nature. Rule of thumb: ask whether the user builds processes around you that are painful to migrate.
